what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as manager (Meera Manager). Tried Home, Overview, Dashboards and the plain-language Ask box; none showed per-person workload. Found Projects > Tasks (Team tasks register): Arjun Architect has 1 open task (Order tiles for master bath, Kapoor Villa (Audit), due 2026-12-05); Sanjay Site has 1. There is no workload summary, no 'this week' filter and no hours/capacity view; I had to infer load by reading the task list. The task is due 5 Dec, i.e. not within this week (today 26 Nov), so I believe his load this week is light, but the app never stated this.

observations: The answer was reachable only by reading the raw task register. A manager wanting to check workload before assigning has no per-person view, no week filter, and the natural-language Ask feature failed on every query including its own examples. Task list itself was clear and readable.

rating_justifications.feature_discoverability: No workload view exists; I tried Home, Overview, Dashboards and Ask before finding Projects > Tasks.
rating_justifications.ease_of_use: Had to manually scan the task list and infer workload; no filter by person or week.
rating_justifications.workflow_efficiency: About 8 wasted actions on dead ends before the useful screen.
rating_justifications.system_feedback: Enter did nothing in Ask; errors said 'I need a little more' without saying what to change.
rating_justifications.error_recovery: Ask suggested examples that themselves failed, and the box was not cleared, so retrying appended text.
rating_justifications.overall_user_experience: Objective only partially met by inference; no explicit workload answer.
